why: tsconfig.json is the npx tsc --init file, and the learner commented strict out ('// "strict": true,') after it flagged greet(name)'s implicit any. tsc reads tsconfig as JSON with comments, so strict is off: that is why npx tsc now compiles silently. dist/index.js exists, but strict mode is not on.

step.title: Turn on strict mode and compile
step.instructions: In tsconfig.json, set "strict": true inside compilerOptions (next to "outDir": "dist"), then run npx tsc in the terminal. It compiles src/index.ts to dist/index.js.
hints: tsc prints nothing when it succeeds.
common_mistakes: Putting strict outside compilerOptions, where tsc ignores it.

Code: // "strict": true,  /* Enable all strict type-checking options. */
